directives.name: The Voice of Reason
directives.title: The Voice of Reason
directives.desc:
In the ensuing political confrontation, Miletiy Zykov, the ideological voice of the Committee and the passionate voice for democracy, achieved the goodwill of the venerable Chairman Vlasov and rose to the rank of the 'second man' in the KONR. Few expected such a contentious figure to become the designated heir to Vlasov, but it seems that his radical ideas and appeal to the people brought the head propagandist of Samara far more weight to his bid for power than his enemies could ever expect.

Of course, the favor of the old general is not enough to protect Zykov from attacks by rivalling factions. Many members of the KONR, especially the more conservative members of Artsezo's faction, have barely concealed their contempt for the "daydreaming demagogue." The usually apolitical Bunyachenko faction have, unusually, also expressed dismay at Zykov's election. The new Deputy-Chairman has yet to prove his worth, but no matter what it takes, Zykov will make every effort to accomplish the goals the Russian liberation movement was founded upon - the overthrowing of tyranny, wherever it may be, and the creation of a new, free Russia, one without Bolsheviks and any exploiters of the Russian blood.

directives.name: Dealing with the General
directives.title: Dealing with the General
directives.desc:
General Bunyachenko and his fellow officers do not oppose us with the same virulence as Artsezo and his clique does. However, our program is still unpopular with the officers. Many accuse us of selling out the hard working men of the ROA for ungrateful rabble that has done nothing but depict us as cowardly collaborators.

Fortunately, we have reason to think that there is still some honor and patriotism among the officers outside of Artsezo's group. The officer's clique and Bunyachenko agree with us that we need at least a small amount of popular support if we're to succeed. We must convince them that offering a democratic Russia is the best path forward.

directives.name: Dealing with Artsezo
directives.title: Dealing with Artsezo
directives.desc:
Our most dangerous opposition consists of the clique of men centered around General Artsezo. Men who see the collapse of Russia not as a tragedy, but as an opportunity to get rich. Encouraged by their German sponsors, the Artsezoite seek to grind poor Russian citizens into the dirt to extract every ruble of loot from this catastrophe.

While we shall work to prevent the spread of this rot any further, a significant group of officers already think like Artsezo. We must thus deal with them, as well as with the leftover German influence in the ROA, if we're to shed away our image as unhinged collaborators among the people.

directives.name: Making Use of Vlasov
directives.title: Making Use of Vlasov
directives.desc:
Whatever could be said about him, one cannot deny that Vlasov is, indeed, a significant person in the thousand-year-old Russian history: A living myth who will be remembered along such figures as Alexander Nevsky and maybe even Peter the Great for his decisiveness to rise against tyranny and lead the Russian people into a new, freer future. As befits any true historical hero, Vlasov's biography is full of wrongful and controversial decisions, and many deprecate him for his mistakes, but they will not be the judges of the Motherlands History.

The stagnation of the internal affairs in Samara caused many people, including both the elite of the Committee and the common Russian folk, to turn on General Vlasov for his alleged apathy to the needs of Russia and his inability to govern the KONR, but his authority among the new Russian government is still indisputable. Combined together, Vlasov's supreme power and his backing of Zykov's democratic reformist bureaucrats will become a battering ram which will break down the discontent of the KONR and open a way to the true reforms we wish to see enacted.

directives.name: Speak with Bunyachenko
directives.title: Speak with Bunyachenko
directives.desc:
General Bunyachenko is long established as the mouthpiece of the officers' committee. However, it is also suspected that his apathy hides secret dreams of a renewed Russia, one able to punish the Germans and Bolsheviks both. Even more important is his influence within the officer corps, as his years of dedicated service have made him a popular, non controversial figure.

It is thus crucial that we begin talks with him, and attempt to bring him closer to our democratic aims. This will be a long ordeal, and one that may never succeed fully. However, convincing him to ask the officers' committee to give us a chance is an easily attainable first step.

directives.name: Speak to the Committee
directives.title: Speak to the Committee
directives.desc: The officers' committee is an important asset in our crusade to liberate Russia. The officers themselves hate the communists and Germans for getting us in this mess. Why not appeal to their patriotism, as well as to their ambition? While it is true that our plan is to eventually give back some power to the common man, the officers of the ROA will still be better off as respected elder statesmen of a strong, united Russia than as petty princes in a backwater military junta. Surely it is an acceptable trade?

directives.name: Speak with Artsezo
directives.title: Speak with Artsezo
directives.desc:
General Artsezo is a hard, cynical man, unconvinced by the idea of sharing the ROA's power with it's citizens. In his little clique lay some of the fiercest opponents to our democratic ideals.

Artsezo himself is also both greedy, and indispensable. His contraband network will be of great assistance to us, and he alone can keep our opponents within the officer corps in line. Why not appeal to his greed? By asking him to help us capture all of western Russia, we can buy off his patience. The rogue general believes us to be an idealistic rabble...and can not expect us to betray him, when the time comes.

directives.name: Talk to the Germans
directives.title: Talk to the Germans
directives.desc:
Our German "friends" in Moskowien and beyond might be busy with their own troubles right now, but the sight of Russian unification on their doorsteps is sure to alarm them eventually.

We still have a little good-will with the Reich for our work in pushing back the communists and bandits. By cashing in every last contempt-drenched favor, we can reassure them that we are merely making a pre-emptive move against the WRRF. In turn, German food and supplies will help us secure our rear as we leave Samara and go off to war.

directives.name: The Power of Radio
directives.title: The Power of Radio
directives.desc:
Radio is the cheapest way to reach every soldier and citizen, wherever they may be. By launching new programs that mix entertainment and education, we can better inform the people of the currently unfolding democratic revolution.

Deputy-Chairman Zykov is known for his oratorical skill and propaganda work. Let us use this asset to diminish the influence of untruths and deception across our land!

directives.name: Bureaucratic Allies
directives.title: Bureaucratic Allies
directives.desc: We know not if Bunyachenko or our other officer contacts upheld their end of the bargain. What is known, however, is that cooperation with the officers' committee has been going a lot smoother recently. It is now time for this cooperation to trickle downwards, and reassure the fighting men that Zykov will lead them to honor, glory, freedom, as well as a decent salary bonus. After all, a poorly organized and poorly motivated army is no army at all.

directives.name: Excising the Rot
directives.title: Excising the Rot
directives.desc:
Artsezo and the Germans think us weak willed and easily subverted once the time comes. Let them dream this, for our own day shall come, too.

With both factions giving us some leeway, it's time to crack down hard on corruption within the ROA. Any German bandit or smuggler caught aiding this blight on the people will be publicly shot. Junior officers, common soldiers and citizens victim to predation in the past will be compensated. By shedding the image of a decaying German junta even further we can in time earn the respect of our citizens.

directives.name: A Renewed Spirit
directives.title: A Renewed Spirit
directives.desc:
A cautious optimism has descended on Samara. Has the ROA always been this popular? Of course it has! Why then are the memories of Chairman Vlasov hated? Vile rumors, of course, caused by the actions of vile underlings that have long been judged by the renewed ROA. Like the good tsar led astray by his wicked boyars, Vlasov has come to dispense justice and help to the people of Samara!

Of course, only a gullible minority preach this gospel. For the rest of the population, the ROA has simply managed to emerge renewed from its stagnation after the end of the German bombings. Curious about where we are going with this, and too cynical to oppose us violently in a quixotic effort at rebellion, our good citizens are themselves beginning to emerge out of their apathy.

directives.title: Begin the Unification
directives.desc: With our internal situation under control, we must now begin our wars of unification. No longer mere hunting dogs for the German, we of the ROA must proudly accept our destiny as liberators of Russia. If every Russian is to live free of fear and oppression, then we must not fail! Soldiers, citizens, onward!

SAM_The_Voice_of_Reason.name: The Voice of Reason
SAM_The_Voice_of_Reason.title: The Voice of Reason
SAM_The_Voice_of_Reason.desc:
In the ensuing political confrontation, Miletiy Zykov, the ideological voice of the Committee and the passionate voice for democracy, achieved the goodwill of the venerable Chairman Vlasov and rose to the rank of the 'second man' in the KONR. Few expected such a contentious figure to become the designated heir to Vlasov, but it seems that his radical ideas and appeal to the people brought the head propagandist of Samara far more weight to his bid for power than his enemies could ever expect.

Of course, the favor of the old general is not enough to protect Zykov from attacks by rivalling factions. Many members of the KONR, especially the more conservative members of Artsezo's faction, have barely concealed their contempt for the "daydreaming demagogue." The usually apolitical Bunyachenko faction have, unusually, also expressed dismay at Zykov's election. The new Deputy-Chairman has yet to prove his worth, but no matter what it takes, Zykov will make every effort to accomplish the goals the Russian liberation movement was founded upon - the overthrowing of tyranny, wherever it may be, and the creation of a new, free Russia, one without Bolsheviks and any exploiters of the Russian blood.

SAM_Dealing_with_Bunyachenko.name: Dealing with the General
SAM_Dealing_with_Bunyachenko.title: Dealing with the General
SAM_Dealing_with_Bunyachenko.desc:
General Bunyachenko and his fellow officers do not oppose us with the same virulence as Artsezo and his clique does. However, our program is still unpopular with the officers. Many accuse us of selling out the hard working men of the ROA for ungrateful rabble that has done nothing but depict us as cowardly collaborators.

Fortunately, we have reason to think that there is still some honor and patriotism among the officers outside of Artsezo's group. The officer's clique and Bunyachenko agree with us that we need at least a small amount of popular support if we're to succeed. We must convince them that offering a democratic Russia is the best path forward.

SAM_Dealing_with_Maltsev.name: Dealing with Artsezo
SAM_Dealing_with_Maltsev.title: Dealing with Artsezo
SAM_Dealing_with_Maltsev.desc:
Our most dangerous opposition consists of the clique of men centered around General Artsezo. Men who see the collapse of Russia not as a tragedy, but as an opportunity to get rich. Encouraged by their German sponsors, the Artsezoite seek to grind poor Russian citizens into the dirt to extract every ruble of loot from this catastrophe.

While we shall work to prevent the spread of this rot any further, a significant group of officers already think like Artsezo. We must thus deal with them, as well as with the leftover German influence in the ROA, if we're to shed away our image as unhinged collaborators among the people.

SAM_Making_Use_of_Vlasov.name: Making Use of Vlasov
SAM_Making_Use_of_Vlasov.title: Making Use of Vlasov
SAM_Making_Use_of_Vlasov.desc:
Whatever could be said about him, one cannot deny that Vlasov is, indeed, a significant person in the thousand-year-old Russian history: A living myth who will be remembered along such figures as Alexander Nevsky and maybe even Peter the Great for his decisiveness to rise against tyranny and lead the Russian people into a new, freer future. As befits any true historical hero, Vlasov's biography is full of wrongful and controversial decisions, and many deprecate him for his mistakes, but they will not be the judges of the Motherlands History.

The stagnation of the internal affairs in Samara caused many people, including both the elite of the Committee and the common Russian folk, to turn on General Vlasov for his alleged apathy to the needs of Russia and his inability to govern the KONR, but his authority among the new Russian government is still indisputable. Combined together, Vlasov's supreme power and his backing of Zykov's democratic reformist bureaucrats will become a battering ram which will break down the discontent of the KONR and open a way to the true reforms we wish to see enacted.

SAM_Speak_with_Bunyachenko.name: Speak with Bunyachenko
SAM_Speak_with_Bunyachenko.title: Speak with Bunyachenko
SAM_Speak_with_Bunyachenko.desc:
General Bunyachenko is long established as the mouthpiece of the officers' committee. However, it is also suspected that his apathy hides secret dreams of a renewed Russia, one able to punish the Germans and Bolsheviks both. Even more important is his influence within the officer corps, as his years of dedicated service have made him a popular, non controversial figure.

It is thus crucial that we begin talks with him, and attempt to bring him closer to our democratic aims. This will be a long ordeal, and one that may never succeed fully. However, convincing him to ask the officers' committee to give us a chance is an easily attainable first step.

SAM_Speak_with_the_Committee.name: Speak to the Committee
SAM_Speak_with_the_Committee.title: Speak to the Committee
SAM_Speak_with_the_Committee.desc: The officers' committee is an important asset in our crusade to liberate Russia. The officers themselves hate the communists and Germans for getting us in this mess. Why not appeal to their patriotism, as well as to their ambition? While it is true that our plan is to eventually give back some power to the common man, the officers of the ROA will still be better off as respected elder statesmen of a strong, united Russia than as petty princes in a backwater military junta. Surely it is an acceptable trade?

SAM_Speak_with_Maltsev.name: Speak with Artsezo
SAM_Speak_with_Maltsev.title: Speak with Artsezo
SAM_Speak_with_Maltsev.desc:
General Artsezo is a hard, cynical man, unconvinced by the idea of sharing the ROA's power with it's citizens. In his little clique lay some of the fiercest opponents to our democratic ideals.

Artsezo himself is also both greedy, and indispensable. His contraband network will be of great assistance to us, and he alone can keep our opponents within the officer corps in line. Why not appeal to his greed? By asking him to help us capture all of western Russia, we can buy off his patience. The rogue general believes us to be an idealistic rabble...and can not expect us to betray him, when the time comes.

SAM_Speak_with_the_Germans.name: Talk to the Germans
SAM_Speak_with_the_Germans.title: Talk to the Germans
SAM_Speak_with_the_Germans.desc:
Our German "friends" in Moskowien and beyond might be busy with their own troubles right now, but the sight of Russian unification on their doorsteps is sure to alarm them eventually.

We still have a little good-will with the Reich for our work in pushing back the communists and bandits. By cashing in every last contempt-drenched favor, we can reassure them that we are merely making a pre-emptive move against the WRRF. In turn, German food and supplies will help us secure our rear as we leave Samara and go off to war.

SAM_The_Power_of_Radio.name: The Power of Radio
SAM_The_Power_of_Radio.title: The Power of Radio
SAM_The_Power_of_Radio.desc:
Radio is the cheapest way to reach every soldier and citizen, wherever they may be. By launching new programs that mix entertainment and education, we can better inform the people of the currently unfolding democratic revolution.

Deputy-Chairman Zykov is known for his oratorical skill and propaganda work. Let us use this asset to diminish the influence of untruths and deception across our land!

SAM_Bureaucratic_Allies.name: Bureaucratic Allies
SAM_Bureaucratic_Allies.title: Bureaucratic Allies
SAM_Bureaucratic_Allies.desc: We know not if Bunyachenko or our other officer contacts upheld their end of the bargain. What is known, however, is that cooperation with the officers' committee has been going a lot smoother recently. It is now time for this cooperation to trickle downwards, and reassure the fighting men that Zykov will lead them to honor, glory, freedom, as well as a decent salary bonus. After all, a poorly organized and poorly motivated army is no army at all.

SAM_Strenuous_Frenemies.name: Excising the Rot
SAM_Strenuous_Frenemies.title: Excising the Rot
SAM_Strenuous_Frenemies.desc:
Artsezo and the Germans think us weak willed and easily subverted once the time comes. Let them dream this, for our own day shall come, too.

With both factions giving us some leeway, it's time to crack down hard on corruption within the ROA. Any German bandit or smuggler caught aiding this blight on the people will be publicly shot. Junior officers, common soldiers and citizens victim to predation in the past will be compensated. By shedding the image of a decaying German junta even further we can in time earn the respect of our citizens.

With both factions giving us some leeway, it's time to crack down hard on corruption within the ROA. Any German bandit or smuggler caught aiding this blight on the people will be publicly shot. Junior officers, common soldiers and citizens victim to predation in the past will be compensated. By shedding the image of a decaying German junta even further we can in time earn the respect of our citizens.

SAM_A_Renewed_Spirit.name: A Renewed Spirit
SAM_A_Renewed_Spirit.title: A Renewed Spirit
SAM_A_Renewed_Spirit.desc:
A cautious optimism has descended on Samara. Has the ROA always been this popular? Of course it has! Why then are the memories of Chairman Vlasov hated? Vile rumors, of course, caused by the actions of vile underlings that have long been judged by the renewed ROA. Like the good tsar led astray by his wicked boyars, Vlasov has come to dispense justice and help to the people of Samara!

Of course, only a gullible minority preach this gospel. For the rest of the population, the ROA has simply managed to emerge renewed from its stagnation after the end of the German bombings. Curious about where we are going with this, and too cynical to oppose us violently in a quixotic effort at rebellion, our good citizens are themselves beginning to emerge out of their apathy.

SAM_Begin_the_Unification.name: Begin the Unification
SAM_Begin_the_Unification.title: Begin the Unification
SAM_Begin_the_Unification.desc: With our internal situation under control, we must now begin our wars of unification. No longer mere hunting dogs for the German, we of the ROA must proudly accept our destiny as liberators of Russia. If every Russian is to live free of fear and oppression, then we must not fail! Soldiers, citizens, onward!
